Our people\-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
   

  

 If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!
   

  

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**
 As our new Senior Software Engineer, you will join SimCorp’s Product Division, a full\-scale agile organization. You will be working in an agile team of about 5\-7 people. The team works on our SimCorp Dimension product. In your daily work you will – together with your team \- understand and challenge customer requirements, discuss solutions, implement and test the chosen solution, and support it. We use a variety of tools, but the main ones are C\#, APL and an Oracle database. You will mainly be working with backend and APIs.
   

  

 The present and near future main topics are good maintainability, high system performance, continuous integration and delivery, and reshaping our product for the cloud.
   

  

 In addition to implementing customer features, it is essential for us to continuously improve on all levels: company, division, product area, team, and individual. Your daily work life will thus also include topics such as “how can we reduce our build time”, “how can we rearchitect this component to perform significantly faster”, and “how can we work together in a more fun and effective way”.
   

  

 We encourage your personal development, and you will be able to spend 20% of your time on experimenting with new technologies and implementing your ideas.
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join an agile team in Portfolio Analytics Product Area.
   

  

 We use a multitude of tools and technologies such as Visual Studio, C\#, Dyalog APL, Azure DevOps within the areas of development and software configuration management.
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
* Most importantly, you can see yourself contribute and thrive in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. You may be a recent graduate from an IT education, or you have another relevant background.
* We expect you to know some of the following and be able to \- and interested in \- learning the rest.
* C\# and .NET development
* Be able to learn additional technologies (like APL)
* Building high performance, scalable applications
* Continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD)
* Experience with Cloud technologies \- Azure Service Bus, streaming APIs \- would be advantage


 Practical experience within financial instruments and financial investment systems is of course an advantage, but not a prerequisite for the job. It is more important that you take an interest in learning this field. We will bring you up to speed using technical and domain discussions, training, and a comprehensive onboarding program.
   

  

**What We Value**
 Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to \- and interested in \- learning the rest.
   

  

* Taking ownership and achieving results
* Trying new approaches to both new and old challenges
* Working with others to leverage the strengths of everyone in the team
* Learning new skills and improving upon existing ones
* Continually looking for ways to improve what we do and how we do it


**Benefits**
* Global hybrid work policy \- We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose, you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* Growth and Innovation \- Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application.
* Self\-Direction \- High degree of self\-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.
* Inclusive and diverse company culture
* Work\-life balance – We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace
* Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes


**NEXT STEPS**
 Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non\-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
   

  

 If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
   

  

 We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000\+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
   

  

 SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry\-leading, full, front\-to\-back offering for our clients.
   

  

 SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best\-in\-class solutions to our clients.

title: Sr Staff Software Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
 It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
   

  

 Join us to put AI to work for people.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Job Description
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Sr Staff Software Engineer (IC5\)** 
 to help build and evolve the foundational platform capabilities that power our products and engineering organization.
   

  

 As a Sr Staff Engineer, you will own significant technical domains and critical platform capabilities, defining their architecture, technical direction, and roadmap. You will design and build highly reliable, performant, secure, and scalable platform building blocks that can be leveraged across multiple engineering teams.
   

  

 This is an
 **AI\-native engineering role** 
 . You will use AI, LLMs, coding agents, and agentic development workflows as first\-class engineering tools across the software development lifecycle—from understanding problems and designing solutions to implementation, testing, debugging, documentation, and operations. You will also help establish the engineering practices and platform capabilities required to build and operate AI\-powered products at scale.
   

  

 You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, driving months\-long initiatives that span multiple teams and have complex technical dependencies. You will identify problems before they are assigned, challenge the status quo, and continuously improve the platform and how engineering teams build software.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities Platform Architecture \& Technical Ownership
   

  

* Design, build, and evolve highly reliable, performant, secure, and scalable platform building blocks.
* Own the technical direction and evolution of multiple platform areas.
* Define and influence the platform team's technical roadmap in partnership with engineering and product leadership.
* Lead architecture and design for complex distributed systems, services, APIs, and platform capabilities.
* Evaluate architectural patterns, technologies, and tooling and make pragmatic decisions based on scalability, reliability, security, performance, and developer experience.
* Establish reusable engineering patterns, standards, frameworks, and tooling that can be adopted across teams.
* Continuously identify opportunities to simplify architecture, eliminate technical debt, and improve platform capabilities.


 AI\-Native Engineering
   

  

* Treat AI as a first\-class engineering capability across the software development lifecycle.
* Use LLMs, coding agents, AI\-assisted development environments, and agentic workflows to increase engineering velocity, quality, and effectiveness.
* Apply AI across problem discovery, design, implementation, testing, debugging, code review, documentation, and operational troubleshooting.
* Develop effective human\-AI collaboration patterns and establish guardrails for AI\-assisted engineering.
* Evaluate emerging AI\-native development tools and incorporate those that provide meaningful engineering leverage.
* Help engineering teams evolve from traditional development practices toward AI\-native software engineering.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive engineering activities and enable AI agents to independently execute well\-defined engineering workflows.


 AI Platform \& Product Capabilities
   

  

* Design and build platform capabilities that enable teams to integrate and operate AI\-powered experiences at scale.
* Lead technical design for LLM integrations, agent workflows, tool calling, RAG, orchestration, and related AI capabilities where applicable.
* Establish reusable patterns for AI reliability, security, observability, evaluation, scalability, latency, and cost management.
* Partner with product and engineering teams to identify opportunities where AI can meaningfully improve product capabilities or engineering workflows.


 Cross\-Team Technical Leadership
   

  

* Partner within and across engineering teams to provide cross\-cutting technical solutions.
* Lead initiatives involving multiple teams, systems, and technical dependencies.
* Consistently deliver deadline\-sensitive work that is interdependent with other engineering teams.
* Drive technical alignment across teams without requiring management escalation.
* Resolve architectural conflicts, technical dependencies, and integration challenges.
* Communicate complex engineering and architectural concepts clearly and concisely to engineers, product managers, and other cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Influence product and engineering roadmaps through strong technical judgment and demonstrated outcomes.


 Continuous Improvement \& Engineering Excellence
   

  

* Challenge the status quo and continuously improve the platform, architecture, processes, and engineering practices.
* Identify systemic problems proactively and drive them to resolution.
* Improve platform reliability, performance, security, developer experience, and operational efficiency.
* Introduce new tooling and standards that reduce engineering friction and increase developer productivity.
* Regularly participate in and lead peer code reviews, engineering design reviews, architecture reviews, and technical discussions.
* Establish and promote engineering best practices across teams.


 Ownership, Execution \& Mentorship
   

  

* Operate independently on ambiguous, high\-complexity problems with minimal direction.
* Own initiatives from problem definition through architecture, execution, delivery, and adoption.
* Anticipate risks and dependencies and proactively establish mitigation strategies.
* Work effectively in a startup\-paced environment with a high degree of ownership and accountability.
* Mentor IC1–IC4 engineers and help raise the technical capabilities of the broader engineering organization.
* Share knowledge, encourage experimentation, and foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement.


**Qualifications**
 Qualifications Required Qualifications
   

  

* 11\+ years of experience designing, building, shipping, and maintaining software products or platforms.
* B.S./M.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Demonstrated experience designing and building reliable, scalable, performant, and secure platforms or distributed systems.
* Experience building and integrating with API\-based platforms, with a strong understanding of REST and other RPC\-based systems.
* Strong experience building and maintaining microservices using one or more of Python, Golang, Java, or C\+\+.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, distributed systems, service design, APIs, databases, observability, security, and reliability.
* Demonstrated experience owning significant technical domains and influencing technical roadmaps.
* Proven ability to lead complex, cross\-team initiatives with significant technical dependencies.
* Demonstrated ability to operate independently, identify problems proactively, and drive ambiguous projects to completion.
* Ability to communicate complex engineering concepts concisely and clearly to both technical and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Strong experience participating in peer code reviews, engineering design reviews, and architecture discussions.


 Additional Information
   

  

**Work Personas**
 We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third\-party service.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.
   

  

**Accommodations**
 We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.
   

  

**Export Control Regulations**
 For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

 . You will own the end\-to\-end delivery of complex features, optimize backend performance, and collaborate on architectural decisions that impact more than 1,000 enterprise customers worldwide.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
 It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
   

  

 Join us to put AI to work for people.
   

  

**Job Description**
 This role requires a blend of technical expertise, leadership skills, and the ability to foster a collaborative and innovative environment. We are looking for a Project Lead familiar with cloud\-native and AI\-native development practices. Our software is built around AI at its core—LLMs, agents, and retrieval systems—and runs on IaaS (Google Cloud/AWS/etc.), so familiarity with these environments and their managed AI services is a plus. Full ownership of your code will be encouraged, including deployment, testing, evaluation, and validation of both traditional and AI components. You will lead a team of software and AI engineers, coaching and mentoring them. Familiarity with CI/CD, test\-driven development, and evaluation\-driven development (eval harnesses for AI features) will be a benefit.
   

  

**Responsibility Area: Software Development**
* Develop intuitive AI\-native software that meets and exceeds the needs of the company
* Development of technical specifications and planning, including model selection, prompt/agent design, and data/retrieval architecture
* Analyze and automate tests for software components prior to delivery, and build evaluation harnesses (accuracy, regression, and hallucination checks) for AI features
* Troubleshoot coding and model\-behavior problems quickly and efficiently to ensure a productive workplace
* Follow secure software coding practices, including AI\-specific safeguards (prompt\-injection defense, data privacy, PII handling, and responsible\-AI guardrails)
* Professionally maintain all software and create updates regularly to address customer and company concerns, including monitoring model performance and drift in production
* IaaS procedures and practices, including managed AI/ML services (e.g., Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI)
* Experience with Kubernetes and containerization is welcome; experience serving models or deploying inference/GPU workloads is a plus


**Responsibility Area: Communication**
* Communicate effectively and professionally in all forms of communication with internal and external customers
* Liaise with team members, management, and clients
* Be transparent about challenges, failures, and successes, including the limitations and non\-deterministic nature of AI systems
* Deliver presentations and write progress reports for stakeholders, translating AI capabilities and trade\-offs for both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Actively seek ways to improve business software processes and interactions, including where AI and automation can add value


**Responsibility Area: Leadership**
* Manage individual contributors' daily tasks
* Mentor software and AI engineers to ensure high product quality across both deterministic code and AI/model behavior
* Perform detailed code reviews, including reviews of prompts, agent logic, and evaluation results
* Evaluate performance, provide feedback and constructive criticism to team members
* Set and track quarterly goals for all team members
* Assist with training and recruitment activities
* Provide status updates, weekly reports, and issue details to senior leadership as needed
* Participate in Root Cause Analysis for customer\-reported issues, including failures rooted in model behavior, hallucinations, or data/retrieval quality
* Aid and support the coaching and training of other team members to ensure all employees are confident in the use of software applications and AI tooling
* Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams including product management, domain specialists, and engineering to define requirements and develop scalable AI\-driven solutions
* Stay current with the latest advancements in AI and related technologies (new models, frameworks, and techniques), and proactively identify opportunities to apply them to our products and services


**Qualifications**
* 8\-12 years of practical Java experience
* 2 years of experience with prompt engineering and prompt/agent scripting
* 2 years of hands\-on experience integrating third\-party AI/ML services and platform APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Salesforce and other SaaS)
* Proven ability to design and manage domain\-specific languages, prompt templates, and agent instruction frameworks
* Develop and optimize microservices that power high\-performance data and embedding pipelines, handling up to 10 million rows and feeding vector stores
* Proficiency in Python, Java, and JavaScript, with strong Python skills for the ML/AI ecosystem
* Experience with RESTful and streaming APIs, model/inference endpoints, web services, and integration technologies
* Knowledge of cloud computing and managed AI services (e.g., AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI)
* Create customer\-centric AI solutions such as RAG assistants, agentic workflows, and AI\-driven customer service
* Create data and knowledge\-base migration tools for SaaS applications, including moving embeddings and vector data between cloud instances
* Experience with LLM orchestration and retrieval frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex) and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector)
* Outstanding collaboration and communication skills
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills, including working with non\-deterministic AI outputs
* Ability to learn quickly, take direction, work independently, and as part of a team
* Ability to develop unit tests and AI evaluation harnesses (accuracy, regression, and hallucination checks) for code components, prompts, and complete applications
* Ability to debug and isolate the root cause of complex issues in probabilistic and distributed systems

Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72\+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
   

  

**A Day in the Life**
 The Endoscopy Operating Unit develops technologies that support the detection, prevention, and treatment of gastrointestinal diseases and cancers. The team combines software, data, and connected device capabilities to deliver digital solutions that enhance clinical workflows, patient management, and healthcare outcomes.
   

  

 This position is based in Hyderabad, India and follows a Flex work arrangement, combining onsite and remote work based on business and team needs. No travel is anticipated for this role.
   

  

 As a Principal Enterprise Software Engineer, you will lead the design and development of cloud\-based software solutions that integrate with connected medical technologies. This role provides technical leadership across the software development lifecycle, driving scalable architectures, cloud\-native solutions, and engineering practices that support secure, reliable, and compliant products.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Lead the architecture, design, and development of full\-stack cloud applications and services that integrate with connected medical products.
* Design and implement scalable microservices, application programming interfaces (APIs), and distributed systems using Python, FastAPI, React, and Amazon Web Services (AWS) technologies.
* Evaluate and recommend cloud services, frameworks, and architectural patterns to improve scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability.
* Drive technical excellence through code reviews, design reviews, testing strategies, and adherence to established engineering standards.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to refine requirements, develop technical solutions, and support product delivery from concept through post\-release support.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation to support quality, regulatory, and business requirements.
* Implement and optimize continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, DevOps practices, and cloud infrastructure solutions.
* Mentor engineering team members and contribute to continuous improvement of software development processes and product quality.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline and 12\+ years of software engineering experience, including 6\+ years of full\-stack web application development using Python.
* Experience designing and implementing enterprise\-scale microservices and distributed systems architectures.
* Experience developing cloud\-native applications utilizing Amazon Web Services (AWS) and container technologies such as Kubernetes and Docker.
* Experience with PostgreSQL database development, API design, event\-driven architectures, and real\-time data processing solutions.
* Experience developing front\-end applications using React or Angular, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience developing software products within the medical device industry or another regulated industry.
* Experience applying object\-oriented design principles and established software design patterns.
* Experience with networking and communication protocols used in distributed systems.
* Experience performing security assessments, risk analysis, and secure software development activities.
* Experience working within Agile software development environments and leading technical initiatives across engineering teams.


**Physical Job Requirements**
 The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.
   

  

 ‌
   

  

**Recruitment Fraud Alert**
 We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:
   

  

 Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.
   

  

 Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate.
   

  

 If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments.
   

  

 If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic.com.
   

  

 ‌
   

  

**Benefits \& Compensation**
**Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package**
 A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.
   

  

 This position is eligible for a short\-term incentive called the Medtronic Incentive Plan (MIP).

title: Integration Developer (SAP IS Expert)
description:
**Job title** 
 : Integration Developer (SAP IS Expert)
   

  

* Location: Hyderabad


 Opella is the self\-care challenger with the purest and
 **third\-largest portfolio in the Over\-The\-Counter (OTC) \& Vitamins, Minerals \& Supplements (VMS) market globally** 
 .
   

  

 Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by
 **making self\-care as simple as it should be** 
 . For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.
   

  

 At the core of this mission is our
 **100 loved brands** 
 , our
 **11,000\-strong global team, our 13 best\-in\-class manufacturing sites** 
 and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.
   

  

**B Corp certified in multiple markets** 
 , we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.
   

  

**About The Job**
 Our team is engaged in designing and delivering Digital Tech Services worldwide. We deliver our solutions in a highly competitive market answering FMCH needs and sometimes supporting highly regulated environments (GxP, SoX, and other regional and local regulations). Our team operates in an international context, serving all markets in most of the countries around the world. To reach our goals we have organized our model around 7 main pillars:
   

  

* Enterprise architecture
* Cloud Infrastructure \& Engineering Platforms
* Digital Workplace
* Integration Platform
* ERP
* Service Now Platform
* Salesforce Platform


**Main Responsibilities**
 This role is a senior technical position responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining integration solutions focused on SAP IS. This includes:
   

  

* Design and develop interfaces using SAP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration, SAP AEM).
* Analyse of business and functional requirements to transform them into scalable, secure, and maintainable integration designs with the support of the architects.
* Build, configure, test, and deploy integration flows (iFlows) following Opella development standards, architectural principles, and security guidelines.
* Collaborate closely with functional SAP teams, business analysts, architects, and project teams to ensure alignment and completeness of integration solutions.
* Perform impact analysis and provide expert estimates for integration development activities.
* Support code reviews, technical validations, and quality checks to ensure consistency and optimal performance across all integration components.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex integration issues, including message failures, mapping errors, connectivity problems, and performance bottlenecks.
* Ensure proper documentation of integration flows, mappings, connection configurations, data models, and operational procedures.
* Follow established release management and change control procedures to ensure safe and compliant deployments.
* Support integration testing cycles, including FUT, SIT, UAT, and regression testing, contributing to test case definition and execution when necessary.
* Drive continuous improvement across integration practices, contributing to automation, reusability, template creation, and shared development assets.
* Contribute to observability and monitoring enhancements for SAP IS integrations, working with platform teams to improve detection and response.
* Mentor junior developers, share knowledge, and foster technical excellence within the Integration Platform team.


**About You**
**Technical Background Required**
* 8\+ years of experience in integration development, with at least 5 years dedicated specifically to SAP Integration technologies (SAP IS(CI), SAP CPI, SAP PI/PO).
* Proven experience designing, implementing, and maintaining enterprise‑grade interfaces across SAP and non\-SAP systems.
* Strong expertise in SAP IS components:
+ SAP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration)
+ SAP AEM
+ Message mappings (graphical, XSLT, Groovy)
+ Connectivity adapters (OData, SFTP, IDoc, SOAP, REST, JDBC, RFC)

* Excellent understanding of SAP data structures, IDoc processing, BAPI/RFC interfaces, and event‑driven integrations.
* Hands\-on experience with authentication and security protocols (OAuth2, Basic Auth, certificates, SAML).
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git\-based development workflows, automated testing, and DevOps practices.
* Good understanding of network, infrastructure, and cloud concepts relevant to integration performance and connectivity.
* Experience working in regulated environments (GxP, SoX) is highly desirable.
* Experience integrating with ERP platforms, especially SAP S/4HANA.


**Soft Skills Required**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to dissect complex scenarios and propose practical, reliable solutions.
* Excellent communication skills, capable of translating technical details into meaningful insights for non‑technical audiences.
* Ability to work collaboratively in global, cross‑functional teams, demonstrating openness, adaptability, and accountability.
* Proactive mindset with a drive for continuous improvement and innovation.
* Strong ownership and commitment to delivering high\-quality work, even under tight deadlines.
* Capacity to mentor and support other developers, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and team learning.


**Why us?**
 At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.
   

  

**We Are Challengers.**
 We Are Dedicated To Making Self\-care As Simple As It Should Be. That Starts With Our Culture. We Are Challengers By Nature, And This Is How We Do Things
   

  

**All In Together:** 
 We keep each other honest and have each other's backs.
   

  

**Courageous:** 
 We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity.
   

  

**Outcome\-Obsessed:** 
 We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity.
   

  

**Radically Simple:** 
 We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be.
   

  

 Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.
   

  

 www.opella.com/en/careers

 One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we’re on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We’re looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 PHY Management team is responsible for the development of the RU (Radio Unti) software for Viasat’s upcoming standards based global LEO NTN network. In addition, the team is also responsible for automated updating, configuration, and monitoring of various SAN components in our existing global Ka band network. Team member responsibilities are to design and implement new features as needed, regularly maintain and update the code base, maintaining applications in Viasat's production networks in a devops model. Team members regularly interact with embedded systems and will need to work closely with the Programmable Logic team and NTN RAN vendor teams in order to support features and required configurations for new devices that are in use.
   

  

 This is a site‑based role, employees work 3\+ days (60%\+) per week from a Viasat office or work location within a standard five‑day workweek.
   

  

**The day\-to\-day**
* Use your experience in O\-RAN based RU M\-plane development and integration of same with other internal RU components
* Integration with other network components (DU, SMO, other SAN/network management applications)
* Design and Implement management applications for Configuring/Updating/Monitoring HW systems
* Maintain and automate CI/CD pipelines for build/testing/deployments
* Support production \& lab environments aligned with team’s responsibility
* Update and maintain existing production applications and networks


**What You'll Need**
* BS in Computer Science or equivalent
* 3\- 5 years of experience working with O\-RAN and 3GPP technology
* Experience with O\-RAN based RU development and integration (C/U/S/M\-planes).
* Very good understanding of O\-RAN fronthaul/M\-plane specifications
* Demonstrated experience in Network programming and embedded environments
* Proficiency with NetConf, YANG, JSON
* Experience integrating multi\-vendor SW (including Open source)
* Used technology/languages include Docker, Kubernetes, Golang, Python, Github Actions, Jenkins


**What Will Help You On The Job**
* Experience working with O\-RAN SW provider focusing on 3GPP, O\-RAN C/U/S/M\-plane development
* Practical CI/CD/devops experience
* Strong software debugging and troubleshooting skills
* Network programming and Embedded Systems experience
* Good understanding of multithreading and OS concepts

title: SB-1501-Senior .NET Developer / Technical Lead
description:
Role Summary
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Senior .NET Developer / Technical Lead** 
 with 7–10 years of strong hands\-on development experience and proven expertise in
 **technical architecture, application security, Azure, code quality, and team leadership** 
 .
   

  

 The role will be responsible for developing and modernizing enterprise\-grade .NET applications, designing scalable and secure technical solutions, reviewing and vetting code developed by other resources, and ensuring adherence to established architectural and security standards.
   

  

 The candidate will work extensively on
 **authentication and credential security, cryptography, Azure Key Vault, API security, secure coding, vulnerability remediation, observability, performance, and legacy .NET application modernization** 
 .
   

  

 The role also requires the ability to lead developers technically, identify implementation risks, make architecture\-level decisions, and actively adopt
 **AI\-driven and specification\-driven development practices** 
 to improve engineering productivity and delivery quality.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Development \& Technical Architecture
   

  

* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise applications using C\#, ASP.NET MVC/Web API, .NET Framework and related Microsoft technologies.
* Analyze existing applications and understand legacy architecture, dependencies, business flows, and technical constraints before implementing changes.
* Design scalable, maintainable, secure, and high\-performing application architectures.
* Define technical approaches, application components, integrations, APIs, data flows, and security mechanisms.
* Participate in architecture discussions and prepare technical design solutions for complex requirements.
* Ensure implementations follow established architectural patterns, coding standards, SOLID principles, and secure development practices.
* Identify technical debt, architectural risks, performance bottlenecks, and security weaknesses and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Work closely with Azure/DevOps resources to ensure application architecture aligns with infrastructure and deployment architecture.


 Application Security \& Authentication

title: Principal Software Engineer - Compilers
description:
**Who We Are**
 This role is part of the
 **Kinara Group at NXP Semiconductors** 
 , combining the agility and innovation of a startup with the scale, stability, and global reach of a leading semiconductor company.
   

  

 Kinara was founded on
 **patented technology developed during the founders’ Ph.D. research at Stanford University** 
 , with a mission to redefine AI inference at the edge through tightly integrated hardware and software. Following Kinara’s acquisition, this mission continues within NXP, with the Kinara team operating as a
 **dedicated AI accelerator and software group** 
 focused on pushing the boundaries of edge AI.
   

  

 The team has delivered
 **two generations of AI silicon shipping in volume** 
 , supported by a
 **mature and production** 
 ‑
 **ready software stack** 
 , making it one of the most proven edge AI platforms in the industry. Kinara technology is used by
 **marquee customers** 
 , including GAFA‑class companies, a leading global e‑commerce provider, and Tier‑1 PC OEMs.
   

  

 As part of NXP, the Kinara Group now benefits from
 **world** 
 ‑
 **class silicon execution, manufacturing scale, and customer access** 
 , while retaining its startup culture, deep AI expertise, and compiler‑driven engineering mindset. Joining this team offers the
 **best of both worlds** 
 : the opportunity to work on cutting‑edge AI compiler and silicon technology, with real‑world impact and long‑term stability.
   

  

**What We Do**
 We build
 **game** 
 ‑
 **changing edge AI solutions** 
 that enable faster, smarter, and more power‑efficient decision making where every millisecond matters.
   

  

 At the core of our platform are
 **Ara AI inference processors** 
 , purpose‑built to deliver
 **unrivaled deep learning performance per watt at the edge** 
 . Paired with our
 **comprehensive SDK and software toolchain** 
 , these processors enable developers to deploy and optimize complex AI models for real‑time inference under tight latency and power constraints.
   

  

 Kinara’s hardware–software co‑design approach allows high‑performance AI to be
 **seamlessly embedded into edge devices** 
 , enabling applications across vision, industrial automation, consumer electronics, and intelligent systems. Our solutions focus on
 **performance, efficiency, and scalability** 
 , helping customers bring advanced AI capabilities out of the cloud and into the real world.
   

  

 Edge AI is at an inflection point, and the Kinara Group within NXP is uniquely positioned to play a
 **leading role in its growth** 
 , delivering production‑proven silicon, a robust compiler and SDK stack, and a clear roadmap for next‑generation intelligent edge devices.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for an experienced
 **Front\-End Compiler Engineer** 
 with 10\+ years of experience to lead the design and development of our
 **AI/ML compiler front\-end** 
 . The role focuses on building scalable
 **model conversion pipelines** 
 that translate models from
 **ONNX, TensorFlow, and PyTorch** 
 into our internal
 **Intermediate Representation (IR)** 
 .
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in
 **compiler design** 
 ,
 **graph\-based optimizations** 
 ,
 **machine learning frameworks** 
 , and modern AI architectures including
 **Transformers** 
 and
 **Large Language Models (LLMs)** 
 . You will collaborate with compiler backend, runtime, performance, and hardware teams to deliver a high\-performance and production\-ready AI compiler stack.

* Design and develop compiler front\-end architecture and model conversion frameworks.
* Build and maintain Python\-based converters for ONNX, TensorFlow, and PyTorch.

* Design scalable pattern\-matching and graph\-rewrite frameworks.
* Enable support for modern AI architectures such as CNNs, Transformers, and LLMs.
* Drive validation, testing infrastructure, regression testing, and CI/CD integration.
* Debug and resolve issues across model conversion, optimization, and IR generation stages.

+ Intermediate Representations (IRs)
+ Graph\-based computation models
+ Compiler transformations and optimizations
+ Pattern matching and graph rewriting

* Hands\-on experience with ONNX, TensorFlow, and PyTorch.
* Experience in graph parsing, graph transformations, and ML model optimizations.
* Strong understanding of CNNs, Transformers, and LLM architectures.
* Excellent debugging, problem\-solving, and technical leadership skills.


**Good to Have**

* Familiarity with AI compiler stacks such as IREE, TVM, XLA, TensorRT, or ONNX Runtime.

title: Senior ServiceNow Developer
description:
**Summary**
**Job Description**
 We are seeking an immediate joiner for the role Senior ServiceNow Developer to take ownership of our platform, providing expertise in ITOM, HR Service Delivery (HRSD), Field Service Management (FSM), finance, and platform development, CSM, SSM. In this role, you will be responsible for translating complex business requirements into solutions, maintaining the platform, and driving our technical strategy forward.
   

  

**Senior ServiceNow Developer**
 Platform Development
   

  

* Finance
* HRSD
* Field Service Management
* Serval AI
* ITOM


**About The Role**
 ServiceNow is central to how work gets done across our IT, HR, finance, and field operations. Teams depend on it every day, and the roadmap continues to grow. We are looking for a senior developer to take end\-to\-end ownership of the platform — someone equally at home designing a clean data model, guiding solution architecture, and resolving complex issues under release pressure.
   

  

 You will serve as the technical anchor across several product lines — core platform development, Financial Management, HR Service Delivery, Field Service Management, our emerging Serval AI capabilities, and IT Operations Management — while keeping the instance healthy, current, and maintainable. This is a role with genuine ownership and influence: we value engineers who challenge assumptions and recommend the right approach rather than simply delivering to spec. Our platform strategy will continue to evolve, and should our direction shift toward a TypeScript\-based AI platform, we want someone who can help lead that transition and any migration away from ServiceNow.
   

  

**Platform development \& architecture**
 Building is at the heart of this role. You will translate complex business requirements into supportable solutions and set the engineering standards the wider team follows.
   

  

* Design and build across Flow Designer, UI Builder, scoped applications, Business Rules, Script Includes, client scripts, and the IntegrationHub.
* Own the data model and CMDB relationships — decide what belongs in a scoped app versus the global scope, and keep custom work from fighting the platform.
* Build and maintain integrations to external systems over REST, SOAP, and MID Server, including error handling and retry logic that survives real\-world outages.
* Set and enforce coding standards, run peer code reviews, and mentor mid\-level developers and admins.
* Build with modern tooling where it fits — TypeScript and the ServiceNow SDK (Fluent) for source\-controlled, IDE\-based development, plus custom UI Builder components.
* Champion out\-of\-the\-box first: reach for configuration before customization, and document the reason whenever you do have to customize.


**Financial Management (Finance module)**
 Finance is one of our fastest\-moving areas. We need someone who understands both the ServiceNow tooling and how finance teams think about and manage cost.
   

  

* Configure and extend ServiceNow Financial Management — cost models, cost transparency, budgeting, chargeback and showback, and allocation rules.
* Partner with finance stakeholders to map general\-ledger data, cost pools, and business services so that reporting is accurate and defensible.
* Build dashboards and reports that give leaders clear, trusted visibility into where IT spend is going.
* Support integrations between Financial Management, the CMDB, and upstream ERP or procurement systems.


**HR Service Delivery (HRSD)**
 You will help HR deliver employee\-facing services with the same rigour as IT — well\-structured processes, clear SLAs, and an intuitive employee portal.
   

  

* Build and maintain HR services, case types, and Lifecycle Events (onboarding, offboarding, transfers) with the right approvals and tasks.
* Design Employee Center experiences, knowledge, and guided journeys that reduce inbound questions.
* Apply strong data segregation, scoped access, and privacy controls to keep sensitive HR records secure.
* Partner with HR operations to automate routine casework while preserving a considered, human experience where it matters most.


**Field Service Management (FSM)**
 Our field teams rely on ServiceNow to reach the right location with the right parts. Reliable scheduling and dispatch directly affect service quality and customer experience.
   

  

* Configure work order management, dynamic scheduling and dispatch, and technician assignment based on skills, location, and availability.
* Support the mobile experience so technicians can work offline and sync cleanly when they reconnect.
* Integrate FSM with inventory, asset, and parts management so that scheduling reflects real\-world availability.
* Refine SLAs, entitlements, and territory rules as the field organisation grows and evolves.


**Serval AI**
 Serval AI is an early and high\-potential area for us. We are looking for someone curious and rigorous, who will pilot AI capabilities responsibly and apply them where they deliver real value.
   

  

* Implement and tune Serval AI across service workflows — case summarisation, resolution suggestions, and generative responses in conversational assistants.
* Extend Serval AI through its TypeScript capability — building custom logic, connectors, and integrations in a type\-safe, source\-controlled codebase.
* Design and refine conversational assistant flows, improving them using real conversation data and deflection metrics.
* Apply Serval AI for classification, similarity, and routing so that work reaches the right team automatically.
* Apply Serval AI over CMDB and asset data — reasoning across Configuration Item and Asset relationships and their lifecycle state to deliver accurate, context\-aware insight.
* Monitor Serval AI quality, guardrails, and cost, and validate that each capability delivers measurable value before rolling it out broadly.


**IT Operations Management (ITOM)**
 A trustworthy CMDB underpins everything else on the platform. You will help keep it accurate and ensure the platform reflects the estate as it truly is.
   

  

* Configure and troubleshoot Discovery and Service Mapping, including MID Server setup, credentials, and custom patterns.
* Maintain CMDB health — identification and reconciliation rules, data certification, and remediation of duplicate or stale CIs.
* Understand and maintain the relationship between Configuration Items (cmdb\_ci) and Asset records (alm\_asset), and map hardware and software lifecycle stages to the corresponding CI operational status.
* Work with graph connectors to ingest and relate external data, keeping CI and asset status accurate and consistent alongside ITOM Discovery and Service Mapping.
* Configure Event Management and alert correlation to reduce noise into a small set of actionable alerts.
* Support Service Mapping so business services are modeled well enough to drive impact analysis and change decisions.


**Platform maintenance \& operations**
 Delivery is only part of the role. Equally important is keeping the instance stable, current, and well\-documented, so that it remains maintainable for the whole team.
   

  

* Plan and execute family upgrades and patching, including impact assessment, skipped\-updates review, and regression testing.
* Run instance health scans, address technical debt, and manage update sets and CI/CD promotion across environments.
* Monitor performance — slow queries, long\-running jobs, and table growth — and address root causes rather than symptoms.
* Manage ACLs, roles, and security so that access is appropriately scoped, and maintain clear documentation so that knowledge is shared across the team.


**Requirements**
**Job Requirements**
 You do not need to be an expert in every module on day one. We value genuine depth in several of these areas, sound platform judgement, and the drive to grow into the rest.
   

  

**Must have**
* Five or more years building on ServiceNow, including senior or lead responsibility on production delivery.
* Strong JavaScript (and ideally TypeScript) with hands\-on command of the core platform: Flow Designer, scripting, ACLs, the data model, and integrations.
* Production experience in at least two of: Financial Management, HRSD, FSM, or ITOM.
* Experience owning upgrades and general platform maintenance on a live, business\-critical instance.
* Adaptable and forward\-looking — comfortable adopting a new TypeScript\-based AI platform should the strategy shift, and able to help plan and lead the migration of workloads away from ServiceNow.
* Certified System Administrator (CSA), plus at least one Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) in a relevant module.
* A clear communicator who can engage effectively with senior stakeholders and technical teams alike.


**Preferred**
* Hands\-on work with Serval AI or comparable AI/LLM platforms and conversational assistants.
* Additional CIS certifications, or Certified Application Developer (CAD).
* Experience with CI/CD tooling, automated testing (ATF), and source control for ServiceNow.
* TypeScript and the ServiceNow SDK (Fluent) for building and versioning scoped apps in code.
* Exposure to ITOM Discovery patterns, Service Mapping, or Event Management at scale.
* Background integrating ServiceNow with ERP, IdP/SSO, or monitoring tools.

description:

 Aqua Security enables enterprises to secure their container\-based and cloud\-native applications from development to production, accelerating container adoption and bridging the gap between DevOps and IT security. We are building a state\-of\-the\-art security platform for large enterprises in the exciting and innovative new field of software containers. Our systems are deployed on thousands of customer servers around the world. A distributed system to watch over distributed systems!
 


* We are looking for a talented Technical Lead to join our server team, in charge of developing Aqua's management console \- a multi\-component system with many responsibilities, performing various background jobs and large\-scale data processing; supplying REST APIs, a web based UI and more.
* In this role, you will take part in further development of our management console, writing features across the entire application stack: SQL queries, business logic, background processes, REST APIs and web\-based user interfaces.
* At Aqua, you will not be writing code for in\-house applications. You will be writing code for large technology companies, banks, government agencies and multi\-national chains.

Almost everything runs inside containers. It is written in Go \- an exciting new language from Google, and heavily depends on free software/open source components. Our web UI is currently written in VueJS. We are primarily a Linux company, but our software also supports Windows and Mac.



  





**Working from Aqua Hyderabad office a minimum of 4 days per week (Mon\-Thu)**

 Aqua Security is the pioneer in cloud native security. Founded in 2015, Aqua Security is a global late\-stage scale\-up and the largest pure play cloud native vendor. title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Compilers
description:
**Who We Are**
 This role is part of the Kinara Group at NXP Semiconductors, combining the agility and innovation of a startup with the scale, stability, and global reach of a leading semiconductor company.
   

  

 Kinara was founded on patented technology developed during the founders' Ph.D. research at Stanford University, with a mission to redefine AI inference at the edge through tightly integrated hardware and software. Following Kinara's acquisition, this mission continues within NXP, with the Kinara team operating as a dedicated AI accelerator and software group focused on pushing the boundaries of edge AI.
   

  

 The team has delivered two generations of AI silicon shipping in volume, supported by a mature and production\-ready software stack, making it one of the most proven edge AI platforms in the industry. Kinara technology is used by marquee customers, including GAFA\-class companies, a leading global e\-commerce provider, and Tier\-1 PC OEMs.
   

  

 As part of NXP, the Kinara Group now benefits from world\-class silicon execution, manufacturing scale, and customer access, while retaining its startup culture, deep AI expertise, and compiler\-driven engineering mindset. Joining this team offers the best of both worlds: the opportunity to work on cutting\-edge AI compiler and silicon technology, with real\-world impact and long\-term stability.
   

  

**What We Do**
 We build game\-changing edge AI solutions that enable faster, smarter, and more power\-efficient decision making where every millisecond matters.
   

  

 At the core of our platform are Ara AI inference processors, purpose\-built to deliver unrivaled deep learning performance per watt at the edge. Paired with our comprehensive SDK and software toolchain, these processors enable developers to deploy and optimize complex AI models for real\-time inference under tight latency and power constraints.
   

  

 Kinara's hardware\-software co\-design approach allows high\-performance AI to be seamlessly embedded into edge devices, enabling applications across vision, industrial automation, consumer electronics, and intelligent systems. Our solutions focus on performance, efficiency, and scalability, helping customers bring advanced AI capabilities out of the cloud and into the real world.
   

  

 Edge AI is at an inflection point, and the Kinara Group within NXP is uniquely positioned to play a leading role in its growth, delivering production\-proven silicon, a robust compiler and SDK stack, and a clear roadmap for next\-generation intelligent edge devices.
   

  

**This Is What You Are Responsible For**
* Implement compiler modules within defined subsystems: MLIR dialects, lowering passes, operator fusion strategies, and target code generation components for our NPU.
* Participate in design and deployment of quantization flows and numerical\-correctness verification for assigned features.
* Develop and ship production\-grade compiler passes and runtime integration components that are stable, debuggable, and performant.
* Perform low\-level optimizations and collaborate with kernel teams to address HW/SW performance gaps.
* Contribute to compiler CI pipelines, test suites, profiling, and release processes.
* Debug and root\-cause performance and correctness issues on customer models; produce reproducible fixes.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to design reviews.
* Provide feedback to product and silicon teams on compiler\-driven feature opportunities and tradeoffs.


**Necessary Qualifications**
* 7\-8 years of software engineering experience with hands\-on compiler and systems work.
* Experience with graph lowering, IR design, operator fusion, scheduling, and code generation for accelerators.
* Strong systems programming skills \-\- proficient C\+\+ and solid Python for tooling and infrastructure.
* Track record of shipping compiler components or systems software used in deployed products.
* Solid debugging and profiling skills with common performance toolchains.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work cross\-functionally with hardware architects and kernel teams.
* Willingness to mentor junior engineers and contribute to team engineering practices.


**Good to Have**
* Familiarity with MLIR\-based frontends and dialects, such as TOSA, StableHLO, TorchMLIR.
* Exposure to AI compiler stacks, hardware backends, or accelerator targeting.
* Experience working with large\-scale models or production ML inference pipelines.

title: Senior Software Engineer (ERP Developer)
description:

With more than 900 e\-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in\-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.
   

  

 At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day \- building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.
   

  

 As we continue to scale our global platform, the Senior Software Engineer will play a critical role in maintaining and modernizing legacy Order Fulfillment and Light Manufacturing systems for the Miramar Supply Chain Tech team.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 Fanatics is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the Miramar Supply Chain Tech team in Hyderabad, focused on sustaining and evolving critical ERP and fulfillment systems built on Microsoft Dynamics SL and a portfolio of .NET applications. This role is central to ensuring the stability of Order Management, Inventory, and Fulfillment workflows while driving integration with modern platforms such as Manhattan Active and enabling a thoughtful transition away from legacy architecture. The Senior Software Engineer delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI\-enabled insights.
   

  

**How Will You Drive Impact**
 Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.
   

  

 Team \& Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)
   

  

* Lead and participate in design reviews and peer code reviews, setting a standard for engineering quality across the Miramar Supply Chain Tech team.
* Collaborate closely with business analysts, cloud and on\-prem partner teams, and cross\-functional stakeholders to align technical solutions with operational requirements.
* Coordinate and synchronize all changes across QC and production environments, ensuring reliable delivery and minimal disruption to critical supply chain operations.


 Fan \& Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)
   

  

* Support ERP workflows through Dynamics SL that directly power Order Management, Inventory Control, and Fulfillment — capabilities that underpin the on\-time delivery of merchandise to fans globally.
* Provide incident resolution and break\-fix support for all Miramar systems, minimizing downtime and maintaining a seamless fulfillment experience.
* Translate business requirements into technical solutions that improve order accuracy, inventory visibility, and fulfillment speed for fans and retail partners.
* Integrate legacy systems with platforms like Manhattan Active to enable a more modern, reliable, and scalable customer fulfillment experience.


 Innovation \& Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)
   

  

* Build APIs and wrapper services that bridge legacy ERP functionality with modern cloud and on\-prem platforms, extending system capability without disrupting live operations.
* Document legacy business logic and contribute to migration planning, helping chart a clear path from current\-state systems to next\-generation solutions.
* Evaluate and apply event streaming platforms (Kafka, Pulsar, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ, SQS) and CI/CD tooling to improve system integration and deployment reliability.
* Deliver full\-stack solutions across the entire lifecycle — from inception through UAT to production — using modern frameworks and containerization practices.


 Ownership \& Execution (Determined \& Relentless Mindset)
   

  

* Maintain version control for all custom applications and ensure all code is archived, documented in GitHub, and tracked through Jira and Confluence.
* Manage SQL Server stored procedures and optimize SQL views and queries, troubleshooting and resolving job or runtime errors as they arise.
* Take ownership of existing workflows and support them using the tools already in place, learning rapidly and acting decisively to keep systems stable.
* Operate effectively under pressure, solving complex problems in mission\-critical environments while maintaining clear documentation and communication throughout.


 AI \& DIGITAL CAPABILITY
   

  

 We are building a future\-ready organization. This role is expected to:
   

  

* Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
* Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
* Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
* Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement


**Required Qualifications**
 CAPABILITIES \& EXPERIENCE YOU BRING
   

  

* Five or more years of software development experience using agile methodology, with at least five years supporting legacy ERP and fulfillment software.
* Hands\-on experience with ERP domains including Order Management, Inventory Control, and Fulfillment — preferably within Microsoft Dynamics SL or comparable platforms.
* Proficiency with SQL Server stored procedures, query optimization, and troubleshooting SQL job or runtime errors.
* Experience writing production software in one or more of the following languages: C\#, Java, Go, or Python, with access to relational databases.
* Familiarity with GitHub or GitLab, containerization, and CI/CD pipelines; experience with event streaming platforms such as Kafka, Pulsar, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ, or SQS is strongly preferred.
* Understanding of APIs, integration patterns, and batch\-driven workflows, with demonstrated ability to build wrapper services connecting legacy and modern systems.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to solve problems effectively under pressure across cross\-functional teams.


**Education**
 Bachelor’s in computer science, Computer Engineering, or a related field required.
   

  

 WORK LOCATION
   

  

 Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located in Hyderabad, India, subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in\-office presence 3 days per week i.e., Tuesday, Wednesday \& Thursday.
   

  

*At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset \- We Build Championship Teams, we’re Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you’re ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast\-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.*

We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. title: Service Now Developer - Software Engineer II
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**National Consulting Services**
 The National Office, a key Strategic Enabler in our new model, is comprised of professionals with various areas of focus that collectively provide mission critical services to support Deloitte’s overall success. Whether focused on project financial, quality and risk management, methods and tools, sales excellence, talent, leadership support, or other activities these professionals ensure that our Firm operates efficiently, and our people are able to effectively serve clients every day.
   

  

**Position Summary:** 
**Service Now Developer**
**Level: Consultant**
 As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need\-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.
   

  

 As a ServiceNow Developer, you will be responsible for development, core configuration, and ongoing technical enhancement of Deloitte’s ServiceNow implementation. You’ll bring a solution\-focused mindset, a passion for customer service, and thrive in a dynamic, high\-velocity environment. You will also have opportunities to build foundational skills in ServiceNow’s AI and automation capabilities.
   

  

**What You’ll Do:**
* Translate functional specifications into logical technical designs; design and develop new ServiceNow workflows and processes.
* Develop and customize ServiceNow solutions (primarily ITSM) using JavaScript, Jelly, MySQL, XML, HTML, CSS, and REST/SOAP web services.
* Build and maintain custom Service Portal pages and widgets to support diverse business needs.
* Assist system administrators with incident resolution and ad\-hoc platform troubleshooting.
* Guide, support, and conduct code walkthroughs for less experienced developers as needed.
* Ensure ServiceNow development and customization align to best practices to maintain compliance.
* Create, maintain, and execute comprehensive unit and integration test plans; coordinate and perform regression testing.
* Document, track, and resolve software defects; participate in UAT and incorporate feedback from business stakeholders.
* Manage Update Set creation and migration; assist with ServiceNow platform maintenance, upgrades, and vendor coordination.
* Participate in requirements gathering, maintain technical solution documentation, and collaborate with business/IT teams.
* Integrate ServiceNow with other enterprise applications using Integration Hub or standard APIs, following secure and scalable practices.
* Develop skills in leveraging ServiceNow’s GenAI features, such as Virtual Agent, NLP\-driven ticket categorization, or AI Search, to enhance automation and workflow effectiveness.
* Assist with basic setup or integration of ServiceNow AI modules and participate in piloting small\-scale AI\-driven solutions with guidance from senior team members.


**The team**
 Our Finance Transformation practice develops and licenses a growing family of proprietary software products (see http://www.deloitte.com/ft) to assist financial institutions with a number of complex topics, such as accounting for credit deteriorated assets and the administration of investments in leveraged loans.
   

  

 We are looking to add dedicated software engineers to our team. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, we provide excellent opportunities for growth and learning and invest in our talent development.
   

  

 We are looking for people who share our passion for translating ideas into relevant and innovative products in the OP to solve business problem.
   

  

**Qualifications –**
**Must have Required skillset:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related technology/business discipline, or equivalent work experience.
* 3–5 years of IT industry experience, including 3\+ years of ServiceNow development.
* Strong experience configuring ServiceNow ITSM Modules using Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, Workflow Editor, ACLs, Script Includes, JavaScript/GLIDE, and HTML5\.
* Hands\-on experience integrating ServiceNow with other IT applications or data sources.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow best practices, solution documentation, and update set management.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills; ability to work as part of a team.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities.
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist or Certified Application Developer (preferred but not required for entry).
* Adaptable, detail\-oriented, and motivated to learn new ServiceNow and Gen AI/automation features as they emerge.


**Good to have skillset Preferred:**
* Experience implementing additional ServiceNow modules such as Customer Service Management (CSM), Integrated Risk Management (IRM), HR Service Delivery (HRSD), or Security Operations (SecOps).
* Exposure to or direct experience working on real\-time AI or automation solutions within ServiceNow or related IT platforms.
* Familiarity with Agile or SDLC testing cycles.
* Experience with day\-to\-day ServiceNow platform administration.
* Awareness of ServiceNow’s AI capabilities (e.g., Virtual Agent, Predictive Intelligence) and enthusiasm for developing expertise in this area.
* Experience using source control tools (e.g., GitHub) for collaborative code development and maintenance.
* Excellent organizational and interpersonal skills with strong motivation for continuous skill development and learning.


**Education:**
* Minimum of a bachelor’s degree (3 Year) within a technical field.


**Location:**
* Hyderabad/ Bengaluru/ Chennai/Pune


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**
 From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.
